# SpaceGame — AI Documentation Index

Routing layer for the system reference in [systems/](systems/). Read this file, pick the
one or two docs that match, read those in full. Do not read the whole corpus.

Every doc has the same shape: **Model → Key types → Flows → Multiplayer → Persistence →
Gotchas → Extending**. `Gotchas` records the silent failures; read it before editing.
Source links inside the docs are paths relative to the repo root.

Companions: [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md) · [INVARIANTS.md](INVARIANTS.md) · [DEFECTS.md](DEFECTS.md) · [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Route by symptom

[ROUTING.md](ROUTING.md) maps what you are *seeing* to the doc that explains it.
**Grep it, do not read it** — it is a long lookup table, not prose:

```
grep -i 'client' docs/AI/ROUTING.md
```
